verdict.rationale: Authoring rich MDX components is a core, applicable axis for a docs platform. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about MDX authoring or built-in components such as tabs, callouts, code groups or steps. The only related items cover a web editor or Git workflow for content changes (mintlify-docs-1) and Markdown export of rendered pages (mintlify-docs-9/23), and neither shows component-based authoring without custom HTML.
